name: Rose Midi Dress
description: A softly structured midi dress with a flattering waist and a flowing skirt. An easy choice for brunch, dinners, and special everyday moments.

name: Ivory Wrap Dress
description: A timeless wrap silhouette with a gentle V neckline and adjustable waist tie. Made for effortless day-to-evening styling.

name: Midnight Slip Dress
description: A minimal slip dress with delicate straps and a smooth drape. Wear it alone for evenings or layer it with a tailored jacket.

name: Rose Tailored Blazer
description: A modern single-breasted blazer with softly defined shoulders and clean lapels. An easy layer that elevates a simple outfit.

name: Cream Denim Jacket
description: A relaxed denim-inspired jacket in warm cream, finished with a neat collar and front buttons. A year-round layering staple.

name: Charcoal Cropped Jacket
description: A cropped jacket with a structured shape and understated detailing. Pair it with high-waisted trousers or your favourite denim.

name: Ivory Slingback Heels
description: Elegant slingback heels with a refined pointed toe and low-profile heel. A polished option for occasions and everyday outfits.

name: Blush Everyday Sneakers
description: A clean everyday sneaker with a cushioned sole and soft blush accents. Adds a subtle touch of colour to relaxed looks.

name: Black Ankle Boots
description: A versatile ankle boot with a simple upper and sturdy low heel. A dependable staple for cooler days and smart-casual outfits.

name: Mini Rose Shoulder Bag
description: A compact shoulder bag with a softly curved silhouette and neat top handle. Just the right size for daily essentials.

name: Everyday Ivory Tote
description: A roomy tote with a clean shape and comfortable shoulder straps. A practical companion for work, shopping, and weekends.

name: Burgundy Crossbody Bag
description: A compact crossbody bag with a structured flap and adjustable strap. Its deep burgundy tone adds a rich accent to neutral looks.

name: Soft Knit Top
description: A lightweight knit top with a relaxed fit and soft texture. An easy layering essential with denim and tailored trousers.

name: Satin Button Blouse
description: A fluid blouse with a classic button front and softly draped finish. A versatile option for work, dinners, and elevated everyday wear.

name: Ribbed Square-Neck Top
description: A fitted ribbed top with a flattering square neckline and comfortable stretch. A simple foundation piece for layering or wearing alone.

name: Wide-Leg Tailored Trousers
description: High-waisted tailored trousers with a flowing wide leg and clean front. Pair with a fitted top or blazer for a refined look.

name: Straight Denim Jeans
description: Classic straight-leg jeans with a comfortable mid-rise fit. An everyday staple that works with sneakers, flats, and heels.

name: Tailored Black Pants
description: Straight tailored pants with a clean waistband and timeless black finish. A dependable choice for workwear and evening outfits.
